items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: Start an act, which did happen. Slim asked me to join permanently, see, which I did.

ctx.x: Start an act, which did happen. Slim asked me to join permanently, see, which I did. Now, we

have to find a name for myself, you know, which we got together and started on and what would match Slim, you know. And, of course, we took a long time to think about it, and it didn't come easy because Slim -- Slim's name was all right, but Slim and Leroy didn't sound so good, you know.
